story:
Why this one matters: Liverpool have not lost a league game. Saturday did not involve them. Bournemouth host them on Sunday.

Xinhua: Liverpool 4 1 3 0, 6 4, 6. Bournemouth 4 0 3 1, 6 7, 3. ESPN's 20 September board still lists vs.

Do not print a Sunday score.
stakes: A first league win for Liverpool would move them into the Saturday pack. They have not played yet.
rivalryAngle: An unbeaten Liverpool side away to a Bournemouth team still looking for a first league win.
